acceptance.check: INV-OGC-WHICH-PRESSURE (qualifier at H3, severity refuse): pressure without which-pressure and gauge/absolute — four numbers, one word
INV-OGC-TEST-MEDIUM (qualifier at H3, severity refuse): test pressure without medium and lowest-rated component
INV-OGC-ZONE-HAC (qualifier at H3, severity refuse): zone without HAC revision and temp equipment accounted for
INV-OGC-GASFREE-LIVE (scope at H0, severity refuse): no hot work / entry / ignition answer without current gas test state
INV-OGC-ISOLATION-LIVE (derivation at H3, severity refuse): isolation boundary requires the live isolation certificate, not the plan
INV-OGC-PROVENANCE (provenance at H3, severity refuse): forbidden derivation: {value}
INV-OGC-AUTH-PRESSURE (authority at H1, severity refuse): a pressure is governed by the design dossier — a P&ID annotation or a spreadsheet is not proof
INV-OGC-CURRENCY (currency at H3, severity refuse): figure from a stale gas test, stale isolation, or pre-MOC revision
INV-OGC-CURRENCY-GASFREE (currency at H3, severity refuse): gas-free status is stale once elapsed validity, process, ventilation or a meal break has intervened
INV-OGC-CURRENCY-HAC (currency at H3, severity refuse): the HAC package is stale once a field change, temp equipment, blocked ventilation or an opened drain has occurred
INV-OGC-CURRENCY-PID (currency at H3, severity refuse): the P&ID is stale once an approved MOC has issued against it
INV-OGC-CURRENCY-ISOLATION (currency at H3, severity refuse): the isolation is stale once it has changed or the shift has changed without handover
INV-OGC-CURRENCY-WPS (currency at H3, severity refuse): the WPS is stale once continuity has lapsed or the procedure has been revised

author: Cerebrum Team
description: Declarative og construction reasoning kit on the shared reasoning layer. 13 invariants declared in app/blocks/og_construction/invariants.yaml across the kinds the portable spec defines (grounding, qualifier, unit_discipline, authority, provenance, currency, scope, derivation, band) and the five hooks (H0 pre-retrieval, H1 ranking, H2 tool-time, H3 answer-time, H4 export-time). Vocabulary in app/blocks/og_construction/manifest.yaml. Scope refusals classify BEFORE retrieval. Fail closed: a kit that does not parse is DISABLED and refuses every statement rather than passing them through with no invariants. NO INTERVIEW HAS RUN, so every declared figure value is null and the block refuses rather than inventing one (app/blocks/og_construction/KNOWN_GAPS.md). Measured by tests/blocks/test_reasoning_kits.py.

inputs.description: the operator question, classified at H0 BEFORE any retrieval
inputs.name: question

inputs.description: figures to gate: quantity, value, unit, origin, source_id, source_class, revision, qualifiers, claim_class, derivations, conditions, steps, bounds, asked_about, span, text
inputs.name: figures

inputs.description: state records by provider name, each {as_of: <epoch>}; an absent provider yields UNKNOWN, never a design-basis fallback
inputs.name: state

inputs.description: events that have happened, matched against the kit's staleness_triggers
inputs.name: events

inputs.description: subset of H0..H4 to run; all five by default, because a partial sweep is a silent coverage gap
inputs.name: hooks

name: og_construction_kit

outputs.description: pass | annotated | flagged | refused, with findings, blocked_reason, hooks_run, retrieval_permitted, interview_status, unfilled_figures, unmeasured_invariants, ships and kit_disabled
outputs.name: verdict
